case_number: 2025 INSC 180; CIVIL APPEAL NO. OF 2025 (Arising out of SLP(C)No.3066 OF 2024)
summary: Motor accident compensation; 100% disability established by Medical Board; Tribunal and High Court erred in relying on own assessment over expert opinion; attendant charges and pain/suffering compensation enhanced; comatose state confirmed; compensation recalculated with 100% disability and 25% future prospects; enhancement in non-pecuniary damages.
legal_provisions_cited: Union of India v. Talwinder Singh
Thresiamma Sebastian v. Dr. Renu Swami Das & Ors.
Abhimanyu Pratap Singh v. Namita Sekhon
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; compensation recalculated and enhanced; Tribunal and High Court awards set aside; respondent to pay increased compensation with interest @7% from date of claim filing till realization.
